sources.title: Claude Code Bridge README.md
sources.locator: Why CCB; Install; Quick start; Message queues; Mobile; Rich mode
sources.finding: CCB launches multiple coding-agent CLIs in visible panes with a persistent daemon, local configuration UI, per-agent message queues, worktrees and a released Flutter Android controller. Optional role packs are separate from core messaging.

sources.title: Claude Code Bridge README.md
sources.finding: ask and returned results share per-target FIFO. Draft protection is recommended for managed Claude/Codex/OMP panes, with a 180-second draft deadline and non-atomic final paste/send caveat.

sources.title: Claude Code Bridge docs/mobile-cloudflare-alpha.md
sources.finding: The alpha Cloudflare Tunnel route keeps the mobile gateway bound to loopback on the server, with Cloudflare providing the public HTTPS/WSS route and CCB owning pairing, device tokens and terminal tokens; cloudflared runs on the server. The guide does not cover LAN or Tailscale routes.

sources.title: Claude Code Bridge docs/releases/v8.7.21.md
sources.finding: OpenCode 2.2 native task submission/idle completion is opt-in; legacy reads use private database snapshots and OMP uses native ingress. Upgrade and provider restart scope is documented.

sources.title: Claude Code Bridge LICENSE
sources.finding: The repository declares AGPL-3.0 and explicitly permits using CCB for free. It also describes separate licensing for closed-source commercial use; this pass does not interpret legal obligations.

sources.locator: Release notes for CCB Mobile Relay (v8.4.0, v8.5.3)
sources.finding: An official or self-hosted encrypted Relay is described with per-invitation data quotas, but no price is given.

sources.title: CCB provider session authority at release v8.7.21
sources.finding: Provider profiles inherit the user's existing provider authentication by default (inherit_auth defaults to true); inherited external auth is used unless an explicit API credential is configured.

sources.title: CCB README release notes: v8.6.10 and Grok login
sources.locator: README.md release notes v8.6.10 (lines 664-667) and line 915, tag v8.7.21 (commit 5516398)
sources.finding: Release notes describe agents reusing the inherited Claude OAuth Keychain credential after an external re-login and refreshing the inherited system Grok login so requests go through each agent's native Grok session.

sources.title: claude_codex_bridge Antigravity support at v8.7.21
sources.finding: Claude Codex Bridge v8.7.21 ships an agy provider with pane-backed execution, native session-log completion, resume and workspace attachment.

sources.title: CCB v8.7.21 README
sources.locator: Platform badge; installation; Native Windows x64 beta; Mobile Android
sources.finding: CCB supports native Linux and macOS terminals and a publicly downloadable Windows x64 beta ZIP. Mobile distribution is a Flutter Android APK; no iOS release is listed.

sources.title: CCB v8.7.21 source
sources.locator: plan_task; _task_create; status transitions; lib/cli/parser_runtime/commands.py plan task-create/status/show/list
sources.finding: The shipped ccb plan commands create persistent task directories and JSON index records containing task_id, title, plan, status, revision and owner. Commands change task state and list/show tasks separately from agent sessions.

sources.title: CCB v8.7.21 source
sources.finding: When maintenance.heartbeat.enabled is configured, the project runner consumes persisted timed schedules and automatically sends a diagnostic ask to the configured assessor when health requires it. It does not automatically repair or start providers.

sources.title: CCB v8.7.21 source
sources.locator: PairingStore device records and scopes; docs/mobile-cloudflare-alpha.md paired scopes and revocation
sources.finding: CCB stores paired device identities/tokens with view, focus and terminal_input scopes and supports revocation. Inspection of the gateway, config UI and lib authentication paths found no human workspace role model or SAML/OIDC SSO integration; agent Role Packs are prompting roles.

sources.title: CCB v8.7.21 source
sources.locator: Workspace worktree operations; lib/provider_backends and terminal launch paths
sources.finding: Built-in workers execute installed provider commands in terminal panes and optional Git worktrees. Bounded inspection of lib/workspace, provider_backends and launch paths found no core-managed container or VM provisioning.

sources.title: CCB core and mobile telemetry search
sources.locator: lib/** and mobile/app/lib/**; searches telemetry, analytics, sentry, posthog; config settings and provider auth paths
sources.finding: The bounded core/mobile search found no product analytics collector or telemetry opt-out setting. The telemetry directory name in cleanup targets Claude-owned files, not a CCB collection client. Provider CLI telemetry is separate.

sources.title: CCB v8.7.21 licensing summary
sources.finding: The licensing summary permits free AGPL use and refers closed-source commercial licensing to the maintainer. It gives no commercial price, billing interval or unit, so it does not establish recurring, seat, usage, compute or one-time pricing.

sources.title: CCB native provider API authority
sources.locator: Authority precedence; explicit agent-local API keys
sources.finding: Explicit agent-local API keys, URLs and routes in .ccb/ccb.config take precedence over inherited provider login state. Claude environment keys and provider routes are preserved as agent-local authority rather than rewriting the global login.

sources.title: CCB provider credential selection
sources.finding: Native provider authority resolves explicit profile environment credentials including ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY. An explicit credential suppresses inherited provider login, establishing own provider API-account use alongside subscription sign-ins.
